children: Roundtable announced a shareholder video call to disclose details of a transformative transaction tied to a previously disclosed $10 million deposit.
CEO James Heckman will host a video call on Sep 17, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET to present transaction details and a financial forecast.
Company describes the transaction as transformational for revenue, audience scale, ad marketplace, operations and capitalization.
The strategic partnership was previously disclosed as a $10 million deposit and additional details expected on the call.
Investors can submit questions via video or text on RTB.io; webinar access provided via Zoom with passcode 792940.
